'''Flour''' is an [[ingredient]] ground from [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]] and the base of [[dough]]. It can't be eaten.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/flour.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
3 wheat grain make 1 flour. A [[Bag of Flour|bag of flour]] crafts back into 9 flour.

== Usage ==

Picking up flour unlocks [[dough]], the [[Bag of Flour|bag of flour]] and the [[cake]]. Flour is used in dough (2 flour and an egg make 4 dough, 1 flour and a water bottle make 1), [[cake]], [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]], [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]], [[gimmari]], [[gnocchi]] and [[Curry Stock|curry stock]].
